integrity: Analytic proof reconstructed. A standard-library finite numerical checker corroborates but cannot prove the unrestricted theorem. Scientific review is not an independent audit.

No global irregular-point optimization, infinite-ring interpolation, or general kernel exponent.
Pre-existing implicit or unindexed variants remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact Fourier-mode staircase and critical conditioning for cyclic Bergman kernels
